name: Modbus TCP gateway (RS-485)
description: A converter in 'Modbus TCP to RTU' mode: it receives Modbus TCP, asks the slave over RS-485 and answers in Modbus TCP. Several systems can read the bus at once (if it allows multi-host), but only Modbus passes, and it hides wire errors behind exception 0x0B.
setup: In the converter's web page: work mode TCP Server, protocol 'Modbus TCP to RTU' (Waveshare: also tick 'Multi-host' if other systems read it too; USR: 'Modbus TCP <=> Modbus RTU').
Set the serial side to the bus's baud / parity / stop bits.
Set the converter's response timeout above the slowest slave (e.g. 500 ms); exception 0x0B means it got no answer in time.
Max connections: as many as the converter accepts — the gateway opens that many.
